intents.answer: The NFSU Library is generally open on working days from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM and on Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Sunday and gazetted holidays follow the university calendar. Please confirm today's status at the circulation desk or on the library homepage before visiting.

Circulation rules vary by user category. Students and research scholars can generally borrow a limited number of books for two weeks, renewable if no one else has requested them. Faculty members receive longer loan periods. Overdue books attract fines as per the library policy. Please bring your valid ID card for all transactions.

All currently enrolled NFSU students, research scholars, and faculty are library members automatically through their institutional record. Visitors and collaborators can apply for temporary membership at the library counter with a valid institutional request. Your NFSU ID card is your library card.

ONOS (One Nation One Subscription) gives NFSU users access to a large consortium of e-journals, e-books, and databases. On campus, access is automatic by IP. Off campus, sign in through the ONOS portal with your institutional credentials, or use the library's VPN guidance if provided. If a resource asks for payment, you are likely outside the institutional access path.

NFSU users can access major scholarly databases such as Scopus, Web of Science, IEEE Xplore, SpringerLink, ScienceDirect, and JSTOR through institutional subscriptions. Availability differs by campus and programme. Start from the library's digital resources page or ONOS for authenticated access.

The library supports citation management through tools like Zotero, Mendeley, and EndNote, and provides guidance on APA, Harvard, and other common styles. For plagiarism checking, use the institutionally provided similarity tool where available. Ask at the research support desk for a hands-on walkthrough.

Completed theses and dissertations are listed in the KOHA catalogue and may also be available through the institutional repository. Research scholars can consult past submissions for literature review. Thesis submission follows the examination cell's format and deadline rules — confirm the current checklist with your school before submitting.

Inter-library loan and document delivery requests can be placed at the circulation desk or by email. Requests usually take a few working days depending on the supplying library. Scanned copies of permitted pages may be arranged for research use.

Besides catalogue search, the library offers reading spaces, printing and scanning, Wi-Fi, research assistance, database training, and guidance on referencing and research communication. Tell me what you are trying to do and I will point you to the right service.

You can reach the library team at the main service desk during library hours, or through the contact details on the NFSU library webpage. For complex research questions, ask for a reference librarian — they can help you search databases and refine your topic.
